title: amauropelta pavoniana
intro: Amauropelta pavoniana, commonly known as the Purple-stemmed Lady fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, with its health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help reduce pain and improve overall well-being. The plant is believed to exhibit therapeutic actions such as analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects, making it a valuable resource for traditional medicine. Bioactive constituents of Amauropelta pavoniana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
